request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into a donut raft: the hull becomes one big fat ring donut of golden biscuit-brown dough #d9a05b floating flat, with thick glossy pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 and tiny white sprinkles on its top; the red tarp becomes a heap of white whipped cream in its middle; the pennant pole becomes a small pink and white candy cane. Nothing red. Keep the oars, size, thick black outline and style the same, with nothing under the hull.
